page.overview:
Who is Heckling Flies?

The Heckling Flies are minor characters in A Bug's Life.

""I only got 24 hours to live, and I ain't gonna waste 'em here," one unimpressed fly says as he and his pals buzz off. Then P.T. announces the finale: Flaming Death. The flies return, hoping the action will finally heat up."
